faq.a: Morgan Crossing at 15735 to 15795 Croydon Drive and 15850 26 Avenue was built 2009–2010 by Larco Investments, per the MLS® strata building record.
Morgan Crossing is 4, above shops storeys with Several buildings above the shopping village.

faq.q: What amenities does Morgan Crossing have?
faq.a: Rooftop gardens, a lounge and meeting room with a kitchen, gated underground parking and bike storage; a fitness centre is part of the village.

faq.q: Has Jared sold homes at Morgan Crossing?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons has listed and sold homes at Morgan Crossing. Call or text 604-928-1361 for the recent sold prices in the building.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings of any listing in the building. Call or text 604-928-1361 or email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca.

Jared has listed and sold homes at Morgan Crossing. If you own here, he knows what buyers in this building pay for, and he can show you the recent sold prices before you decide. Call or text 604-928-1361.

Before you buy at Morgan Crossing

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Morgan Crossing owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
